headline: Cal State LA lead the division on wins outright
dek: Cal State LA beat Western Oregon at home and remain without a defeat all season. Seattle Pacific, Charleston and Francis Marion are the nearest on wins, and Regis travel to Cal State LA next.
displaced_by: form: the standing headline ran to eleven words; its story is still true and stands, recast at nine words, and the dek's last clause now names Cal State LA instead of an ambiguous 'them'
